reasons: Cited Sections 11.1-11.3 substantively meet the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at Customer's request, return of all Customer Data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and secure deletion with written officer certification after Customer confirms successful return.
No walk-away features present (no immediate deletion, no refusal to return data); rate basis tied to expiring Order Form rates is at least as favorable to us as 'then-current rates'.
Consistent with a compliant classification, the redline is unchanged and no counterparty comment was proposed; deterministic check confirms a data return/transition clause is present.
